reason: Before the fix, unsupported Y/YYY tokens fell through to the timezone-offset fallback, so a lone 'Y' rendered as an offset like '+0000' and 'YYY' did not return '24Y'.
The PR makes format() preserve unsupported year tokens literally and handle ZZ explicitly, so 'Y' returns 'Y' and 'YYY' returns e.g. '24Y'.
The PR only extracts the existing percent-decode-if-needed logic into a shared helper; the inline path already decoded '%20' to a space, so the behavior is preserved at base.
The refactor is behavior-preserving (exported helper does the same decode), so route parameters are still decoded at head.
Before the fix reschedule() wrote the new score to Redis but never updated @score, so entry.score/at kept returning the stale pre-reschedule values.
The fix sets @score = at.to_f after zincrby, so the in-memory handle reflects the new reschedule time immediately.
The PR only trims optional whitespace in Range-header parsing; Content-Type/charset parsing is an unrelated, already-supported feature that is unaffected.
The Range-header whitespace change does not touch Content-Type parsing, which already reads 'text/plain; charset=UTF-8' with its charset parameter.
The PR only changes download-failure logging in ComposerRepository and does not touch archiving; zip archiving preserving source mtimes is expected pre-existing behavior unaffected by the change.
The logging-only PR is unrelated to the zip archiver, so re-archiving still preserves source modification times as before.
The PR changes CredentialCache URI prefix matching, which is unrelated to System.Text.Json deserialization; async deserialize of a list with a nullable parent property already works.
Synchronous and async JSON deserialization are unaffected by the unrelated CredentialCache change and produce equivalent results.
The PR fixes FETCH FIRST on empty WITH HOLD cursors, unrelated to INET containment operators; INET '192.168.1.5' <<= ANY(...) already parses and executes returning true.
The cursor fix does not affect INET operator parsing; '10.0.0.0/8' >>= ANY(ARRAY[...]) is supported and returns true without a syntax error.
Before the fix an IPv6 NO_PROXY entry such as '::1' was transformed into a pattern a later URL parse could not interpret, raising an error during client construction.
The fix handles IPv6 (and IPv4/localhost) NO_PROXY entries separately, so '::1' is recognized as a bypass host and the client is created without error.
Before the fix Series.str.match raised for any regex flag other than IGNORECASE, so enabling the dot-matches-newline (DOTALL) option was rejected rather than honored.
The fix restores support for flags such as DOTALL (passed via flags= or carried by a compiled pattern), so the newline-matching option is honored.
Before the fix a chain with a group and more than two tasks after it broke result-tree parent linking, so serializing/reconstructing dropped child results of the parallel groups.
The fix keeps prev_task/prev_res correct for groups in the middle of a chain, so reconstruction preserves all four child results across both parallel groups.
Before the fix encountering '--' switched the parser into trailing-values mode, so '--check' became a trailing value and the second positional stayed empty instead of receiving '--check'.
The fix lets the current positional's value_terminator (matching '--') take precedence over trailing-values mode, so the second positional collects '--check'.
Before the fix a late-arriving OSC11 response triggered OptionSet via nvim_set_option_value('background',...), so both OptionSet and ColorScheme autocommands fired as the test expects.
The fix wraps the background set in :noautocmd to suppress OptionSet for OSC11, so the expected OptionSet (and thus the test's autocommand expectations) no longer fire.
The PR only reorders a compile-time dependency check for Inspect derive and does not change validation; omitting a required field still marks the changeset invalid with a blank error.
The compile-time dependency reordering is unrelated to required-field validation, which continues to flag the changeset invalid with a 'can't be blank' message.
